title_as_printed: Experimental data and correlation of water activities of MgSO4 solutions by molar vapor pressure depression

footnotes_as_printed.table: aw = (p/p0); S. D. = +/- 0.03% (printed below the 150 C block)

property_description: water activity aw = p/p0 (ratio of solution vapour pressure to pure-water vapour pressure at the same T), from differential isoteniscope measurement; corrected for water-vapour non-ideality and for water evaporated in the isoteniscope
pressure_note: not applicable; vapour pressure itself is not tabulated, only aw = p/p0

composition.note: molality column header printed only as 'm'; unit mol/kg inferred from the paper's symbol list ('m molality of the solution'); concentration corrected by authors for water evaporated in the isoteniscope

skip_rows.reason: temperature block label rows (also carried by group_rows)

extra_unmapped: (aw)calc. (value calculated from the authors' correlation k = a + b mu^1/2; not measured)
conversion_needs: water activity is a derived-from-measurement quantity (aw = p/p0); the database must map it to its own water-activity/vapor-pressure property; T per block from label rows, in C
notes: Four temperature blocks printed side by side, stacked here with one label row per block (e.g. '75 C'), label rows are carried by group_rows (T.constant). The last (aw)calc. of the 150 C block is printed 0.8988 (probably a misprint for 0.9988; aw exp 0.9882 and the other three temperatures give 0.986-0.988), kept as printed; it is a calculated column and not mapped.
quality_remarks: builder: the authors corrected for vapour non-ideality at high T (text), so aw above 373 K is accepted and tagged.
